documents_reference_present.name: documents_reference_present
documents_reference_present.value: "documents"."customer_id" is not null or "documents"."application_id" is not null

journal_entries_reversal_consistent.name: journal_entries_reversal_consistent
journal_entries_reversal_consistent.value:
("journal_entries"."kind" = 'standard' and "journal_entries"."reverses_entry_id" is null)
          or ("journal_entries"."kind" = 'reversal' and "journal_entries"."reverses_entry_id" is not null)

payments_provider_reference_unique.name: payments_provider_reference_unique
payments_provider_reference_unique.where: "payments"."provider" is not null and "payments"."external_reference" is not null

platform_invitations_acceptance_consiste.name: platform_invitations_acceptance_consistent
platform_invitations_acceptance_consiste.value:
("platform_invitations"."status" = 'accepted' AND "platform_invitations"."accepted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "platform_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("platform_invitations"."status" <> 'accepted' AND "platform_invitations"."accepted_by" IS NULL AND "platform_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL)

reconciliation_items_amounts_nonnegative.name: reconciliation_items_amounts_nonnegative
reconciliation_items_amounts_nonnegative.value:
("reconciliation_items"."internal_amount" is null or "reconciliation_items"."internal_amount" >= 0)
          and ("reconciliation_items"."provider_amount" is null or "reconciliation_items"."provider_amount" >= 0)

tenant_invitations_acceptance_consistent.name: tenant_invitations_acceptance_consistent
tenant_invitations_acceptance_consistent.value:
("tenant_invitations"."status" = 'accepted' AND "tenant_invitations"."accepted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "tenant_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("tenant_invitations"."status" <> 'accepted' AND "tenant_invitations"."accepted_by" IS NULL AND "tenant_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL)

tenant_kyb_cases_review_consistent.name: tenant_kyb_cases_review_consistent
tenant_kyb_cases_review_consistent.value:
("tenant_kyb_cases"."reviewed_at" is null and "tenant_kyb_cases"."reviewed_by" is null)
        or ("tenant_kyb_cases"."reviewed_at" is not null and "tenant_kyb_cases"."reviewed_by" is not null)

tenants_archive_consistent.name: tenants_archive_consistent
tenants_archive_consistent.value:
("tenants"."archived_at" is null
            and "tenants"."archived_by" is null
            and "tenants"."archive_reason" is null)
          or ("tenants"."archived_at" is not null
            and "tenants"."archived_by" is not null
            and "tenants"."archive_reason" is not null
            and length(btrim("tenants"."archive_reason")) >= 3
            and "tenants"."active" = false)
